Text: WHEN the POS sends a voucher validation request, the loyalty service shall respond within TBD ms.
Rationale: Checkout must not get slower (SH-02); target value is open question Q4 to SH-02.

Text: WHEN the POS reports that a voucher was applied, the loyalty service shall quickly mark the voucher as Applied.
Rationale: A voucher must not be applied twice.

Text: WHEN a support agent cancels a voucher in the admin console, the loyalty service shall return the voucher points to the member's posted balance.
Rationale: Support needs a way to undo a voucher issued by mistake.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service receives a voucher validation request for a voucher in state Expired, the loyalty service shall return the reason Expired to the POS.
Rationale: Cashiers need to tell the member why a voucher was refused.
